title: Sorghum leaf blight multi-environment genomic analysis
description: Reproducible software for multi-environment genomic analysis of sorghum leaf blight incidence and severity in West African field evaluations. The workflow reconstructs accession phenotypes from plot-level observations, applies official GEMMA 0.98.5 leave-one-chromosome-out score tests for primary inference, uses likelihood-ratio tests as a sensitivity analysis, compares ACAT and Simes p-value combinations, evaluates conditional severity, accounts for genotype-equivalent markers through LD-based clumping, and reports effect estimates, confidence intervals, detectable-effect calculations, and leave-one-location-out stability.
